objective: Test a separate economics-v3 lineage after v2 produced no development-eligible policy. Restrict to WIDE, cap the long-odds tail, require frozen-model probability/agreement, and freeze one meeting-robust policy before any fresh target is fetched.

v2_fresh_target_firewall.interpretation: The five fixed v2 validation meetings were never fetched or settlement-scored and remain fresh only because this v3 rule is frozen before any access.

development_basis_not_confirmatory: Economics-v1 failed untouched validation and is burned as confirmatory evidence.
Economics-v2 used the ten already exposed economics meetings as development and found no policy satisfying all preregistered robustness criteria; its fresh validation targets were not accessed.
Post-v2 development diagnostics motivate WIDE-only shorter-odds higher-conservative-probability testing. This is development-only and cannot count as v3 validation.

selection_semantics.enumeration: For each fixed meeting enumerate day_index 01..04 and race_no 01..12; retain every race whose mandatory PRE parse and confirmed closing-price parse pass; no replacement after settlement access.

purchase_policy_family.description: WIDE-only stability family; at most one flat-100-yen ticket per race.

development_selection.no_eligible_policy_rule: If no candidate is eligible, persist NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_POLICY and do not fetch any v3 validation target.

validation_gate.C5_bootstrap: 10000 whole-race bootstrap replicates, seed 20260913, 95% ROI lower bound > 0
validation_gate.POSITIVE_BUT_UNCERTAIN: coverage and C1-C4 pass but C5 fails
validation_gate.FAIL: coverage passes and any of C1-C4 fails

phase_firewall: No v3 validation PRE, PRICE, RESULT, or PAYOUT access is allowed until one development policy is frozen.
Development PRE and PRICE are locked before development SETTLEMENT scoring.
Validation PRE/PRICE and ticket decisions are frozen before validation SETTLEMENT parser invocation.
No validation-derived retune, replacement, threshold change, market change, deletion, rescue scoring, or fresh-target reuse after access is allowed.
No DEV2000 RESULT/PAYOUT and no ECON_HOLDOUT1000 bytes may be opened by this lineage.
scientific_claim_boundary: Even PASS is historical KR-015 economics evidence only. It does not authorize Runtime, live orders, automatic betting, or real-money wagering.
